mapper.select: SELECT rmp.id, rmp.role_id, r.name AS role_name, r.code AS role_code, rmp.menu_id, m.name AS menu_name, rmp.created_at, rmp.updated_at FROM role_menu_permissions rmp LEFT JOIN roles r ON rmp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN menus m ON rmp.menu_id = m.id ORDER BY r.id ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT rmp.id, rmp.role_id, r.name AS role_name, r.code AS role_code, rmp.menu_id, m.name AS menu_name, rmp.created_at, rmp.updated_at FROM role_menu_permissions rmp LEFT JOIN roles r ON rmp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN menus m ON rmp.menu_id = m.id WHERE rmp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.id ASC
